title.en: A funny toast for a friend
title.es: Un brindis gracioso para un amigo

es: Preparar un brindis de cumpleaños con bromas amables, una hipérbole con so/such y una revisión que elimina lo ofensivo.

teaching.en: Please raise a glass to Sara, who is so generous that she once shared her last sandwich with a stranger.
teaching.es: Levantemos la copa por Sara, que es tan generosa que una vez compartió su último sándwich con un desconocido.
teaching.explanationEs: Hipérbole amable: elogia con una exageración simpática.
segments: Please raise a glass to Sara, who is so generous
that she once shared her last sandwich with a stranger.
teaching.audioText: Please raise a glass to Sara, who is so generous that she once shared her last sandwich with a stranger.

teaching.en: A little teasing is fine in a toast if the whole room, including Sara, can laugh.
teaching.es: Un poco de broma cariñosa está bien en un brindis si toda la sala, incluida Sara, puede reírse.
teaching.explanationEs: La broma debe ser cariñosa: la persona homenajeada también tiene que reírse.
segments: A little teasing is fine in a toast
if the whole room, including Sara, can laugh.
teaching.audioText: A little teasing is fine in a toast if the whole room, including Sara, can laugh.

teaching.en: I will not tell the embarrassing story about the holiday photos; Sara would never forgive me.
teaching.es: No contaré la historia vergonzosa de las fotos de vacaciones; Sara no me lo perdonaría nunca.
teaching.explanationEs: Lo que avergüenza a la persona no entra en un brindis.
segments: I will not tell the embarrassing story about
the holiday photos; Sara would never forgive me.
teaching.audioText: I will not tell the embarrassing story about the holiday photos; Sara would never forgive me.

teaching.en: That joke about her age was offensive, so I will revise my speech.
teaching.es: Esa broma sobre su edad era ofensiva, así que revisaré mi discurso.
teaching.explanationEs: Revisar es quitar o cambiar lo que puede herir antes de leerlo.
segments: That joke about her age was offensive,
so I will revise my speech.
teaching.audioText: That joke about her age was offensive, so I will revise my speech.

teaching.en: Cheers to Sara! A warm smile can tone down any joke.
teaching.es: ¡Por Sara! Una sonrisa cálida puede suavizar cualquier broma.
teaching.explanationEs: Tone down = suavizar; cheers cierra el brindis.
segments: Cheers to Sara! A warm smile
teaching.audioText: Cheers to Sara! A warm smile can tone down any joke.

prompt.es: Elige la broma más adecuada para un brindis de cumpleaños.

choices.text: Ana is so generous that she cooks for the whole street!
Ana is so old that she remembers the first telephone!
Ana is so poor that she cooks with one egg!

feedback.es: Solo la frase de la generosidad exagera una virtud; las otras bromean con la edad o el dinero, que pueden ofender.

hint.es: Elogia un rasgo positivo; evita la edad y el dinero.

origin.text: You write a toast for your friend Ana, who cooks for everybody.

prompt.es: Completa: «¡Por favor, levanten una copa por Sara!»

feedback.es: Se dice raise a glass to…: levantar la copa antes de decir cheers.

hint.es: Es lo que se hace con la copa justo antes de decir cheers.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Sara es tan generosa que comparte su comida con los vecinos.»

answer.text: Sara is so generous that she shares her food with the neighbours

feedback.es: So + adjetivo + that + resultado: so generous that she shares her food.

hint.es: Empieza por el sujeto y sigue con so + adjetivo + that.

prompt.es: Escucha el brindis y elige qué hace la hablante.

choices.text: She complains that Ana never has a plan.
She jokes kindly about Ana's planning and ends with a cheers.
She is angry and stops the toast.

feedback.es: Exagera con so organised that, avisa con I am only joking y cierra con cheers: es un brindis cariñoso.

origin.audio: Everyone, this toast is for my friend Ana. She is so organised that she has a plan for her plans. I am only joking. Cheers, Ana!

prompt.es: Revisa el borrador del brindis y elige el comentario que debe quitarse.

choices.text: Tom is so late that he misses his own parties.
Still, he is such a good friend!
He is also so poor that he cannot buy a coffee.

feedback.es: La broma sobre el dinero puede herir; la del retraso es amable y el elogio final es sincero.

origin.text: Draft toast: Tom is so late that he misses his own parties. He is also so poor that he cannot buy a coffee. Still, he is such a good friend!

prompt.es: Completa: «Tanto Mia como Leo ayudaron con el pastel.»

feedback.es: Both se une a and: «tanto… como»; los dos sujetos ayudaron.

origin.text: Both Mia ___ Leo helped with the cake.

prompt.es: Lee la escena y elige qué hace Mia con su comentario sobre el pastel.

choices.text: She plays down a bad surprise.
She says exactly what she planned.
She says the opposite, in a sarcastic tone.

feedback.es: Un pastel en el suelo es un mal momento; «not exactly what I planned» lo minimiza: es un understatement.

origin.text: Mia's birthday cake falls on the floor. Mia looks at it and says, “Well, that is not exactly what I planned.”

prompt.es: Elige los dos sentidos del chiste del brindis para el pastelero Tom.

choices.text: It is hard, and it is really bread.
It is easy, and it is really cake.
It is sweet, and it is really a party.

feedback.es: «A piece of cake» significa algo muy fácil y, para un pastelero, también es literalmente un trozo de pastel.

origin.text: Toast for Tom, our baker: “Making your own birthday cake is a piece of cake for you!”

prompt.es: Escucha y decide si Leo es sincero o sarcástico.

choices.text: Leo is sincere: the toast was very short.
Leo is sarcastic: the toast was very funny.
Leo is sarcastic: the toast was very long.

feedback.es: Un brindis de cuarenta minutos contradice «short»; la risa de Sara confirma el sarcasmo.

origin.audio: Mia's toast lasted forty minutes. Leo whispered to Sara, Oh, what a short toast. Sara laughed.

prompt.es: Escribe un brindis para Sara con dos bromas amables y una hipérbole so/such.

answer.text: Friends and family, please raise a glass to Sara! She is so generous that she cooks for the whole street, and she is so late for everything that she arrived at her own party after the cake. I am only joking: we would wait for her all night. Sara is kind of messy in the kitchen, but she is such a good friend that nobody minds. I will not make a joke about her age, because that would not be fair to her. We are lucky to have her in our lives. Thank you for always being there for us. Cheers, Sara, and happy birthday!
accepted: Friends and family, please raise a glass to Sara! She is so generous that she cooks for the whole street, and she is so late for everything that she arrived at her own party after the cake. I am only joking: we would wait for her all night. Sara is kind of messy in the kitchen, but she is such a good friend that nobody minds. I will not make a joke about her age, because that would not be fair to her. We are lucky to have her in our lives. Thank you for always being there for us. Cheers, Sara, and happy birthday!

Friends, let us raise a glass to Sara! She is so kind that she helps everybody, and she is so forgetful that she once looked for her phone while she was talking on it. I am just joking: we love her exactly as she is. Sara is sort of famous for her terrible maps, but she is such a generous friend that we always follow her anyway. I will not joke about her age, because that would not be fair to her. We are lucky to have her in our lives. Thank you for every good day. Cheers to Sara, and happy birthday!

feedback.es: El brindis completo tiene bromas amables, una hipérbole con so/such… that, un suavizador y un cierre sincero.

origin.text: Sara cumple 30 años. Es muy generosa, siempre llega tarde y cocina para todos. Escribe en inglés un brindis de 100–140 palabras: dos bromas amables, una hipérbole con so/such… that, un suavizador (kind of, I am only joking), una broma sobre la edad que decides no hacer y un cierre sincero con cheers.

prompt.es: ¿Cómo puedes suavizar una broma que podría parecer demasiado fuerte?

choices.text: Add “kind of” and say “I am only joking.”
Say it again, but louder.
Make the joke about his age.

feedback.es: Kind of y I am only joking rebajan la intensidad; repetirla más alto o aludir a la edad la empeora.

prompt.es: Completa: «Tom es tan buen amigo que le perdonamos sus bromas.»

feedback.es: Con un nombre (friend) se usa such a: such a good friend that…

origin.text: Tom is ___ a good friend that we forgive his jokes.

prompt.es: Escucha el final del brindis y elige qué hace el hablante.

choices.text: He criticises Leo and leaves.
He teases kindly and finishes with praise.
He forgets what to say and stops.

feedback.es: Bromea con una hipérbole, aclara que es broma y cierra con un elogio y cheers.

origin.audio: Leo is so forgetful that he forgot his own birthday. I am only joking. He is a great friend. Cheers!
